title: The Full Peal
notes: Terminal defeat in either Cathedral phase. It cannot fall back to Chapel.

lines.text: The first bell finds the crossing. The second finds the Surfer.
By the third, the distinction between the two available bodies has become an acoustic problem.
That is what they were for.
Four. The screen answers at the same distance as the screen in Ellery Chapel, though nobody here measures it.
Five. Cold glass gives back the same chord from another building and refuses to explain the correspondence.
Six completes the return through both of you. The bell mouths do not move.
No porch opens. No chapel inherits the run. The demolition remains paperwork for a morning that belongs to another route.
